candidates.name: Sphenoid sinusitis
support_spans: enlargement of the right sphenoid sinus
purulent discharge in the sphenoethmoidal recess
candidates.why: The patient presented with symptoms and imaging findings consistent with sphenoid sinusitis.

candidates.name: Trigeminal neuralgia
support_spans: 6 months of progressive right mandibular pain radiating to the zygomatic and mastoid regions
candidates.why: The patient's initial presentation was consistent with trigeminal neuralgia, but the lack of response to prednisone suggests an alternative diagnosis.

candidates.name: Pterygopalatine fossa syndrome
support_spans: soft tissue protruding through breach in the lateral recess wall of the sphenoid sinus, invading the right internal pterygoid muscles, masticatory and pterygopalatine fossae
candidates.why: The patient's imaging findings suggest involvement of the pterygopalatine fossa.

candidates.name: Cavernous sinus syndrome
support_spans: intracranial extension into the cavernous sinus surrounded the Gasserian ganglion
candidates.why: The patient's imaging findings suggest involvement of the cavernous sinus.

candidates.name: Skull base osteomyelitis
support_spans: persistent inflammation of the sphenoid sinus, skull base, and pterygoid fossa on follow-up MRI
candidates.why: The patient's persistent inflammation on follow-up MRI suggests a possible diagnosis of skull base osteomyelitis.

candidates.name: Invasive fungal sinusitis
support_spans: enlargement of the right sphenoid sinus
soft tissue protruding through breach in the lateral recess wall of the sphenoid sinus
contradict_spans: negative for hyphae and neoplastic cells
cultures grew no bacteria or fungi
candidates.why: The patient's imaging findings suggest a possible fungal infection, but the lack of evidence on histopathology and cultures makes this diagnosis less likely.

candidates.why: The patient's presentation with purulent discharge suggests a possible bacterial infection, but the lack of evidence on cultures makes this diagnosis less likely.
